---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with collection, measurement, replay or installation
---

## Reproduce

Give the package or app version and the smallest sequence of actions that shows the problem. For device issues, include the sensor, phone model and OS.

## Expected and observed

For measurement errors, include the channel, units, source time interval and expected value.

## Evidence

Attach a short shareable session, a minimal input or the relevant build output. Remove private readings, credentials and local endpoints.
